answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before earning rewards, then slash it when a randomly selected audit proves a claim was fabricated. A plume of Sybil accounts now requires separate capital: the attacker must fund every identity and risks losing each bond, so creating many accounts costs money rather than just an email address. Keep audits evidence-based, not tied to account age; even at the market’s nadir, the copper bond makes attacks costly, though not impossible.
